messages.text: Happy to. Which unit are you weighing up, and where are you mining? Give me the state or country and I'll run the sats per month, your power cost and the break-even for the Harlo B30 and the Magic Miner 40T side by side. If you've got an order number with us, give me that instead and I'll pull the address off it.
